acceptanceCriteria: The lane/batch merge guidance (docs or dogfood batch tooling) says not to use -X theirs for shared append-only spec files, or the batch check detects a lost section (requirement IDs present before merge missing after).
A test or check covers the dropped-appended-section case.
body: Found by CEM dynamic lane V1-0592 (PR beamfall/corvint#1003, head 1398a8c24, base origin/main 7c9a52d90, corvint build 615) on 2026-10-17. Evidence: /private/tmp/cem10-build/dynamic-2026-10-17/. Lane procedure: before pushing, `git merge -X theirs origin/main`. When two lanes both append a section at the end of docs/specs/test-runner-execution-v0.md, -X theirs silently discarded the lane's own section; the lane restored it by hand (61571c3f6). Expected: the documented lane merge procedure detects or avoids this.

completion.reason: DONE per 2026-10-21 v1-0 ticket audit, independently verified against origin/main ef2a01db5: 2ed823df1; docs/DOGFOOD.md:506-509; internal/dogfoodflow/batch_test.go:258. -X ours/theirs banned in guidance, dropped hunks reported with test

title: Lane charter merge -X theirs silently drops one of two sections appended at the same spec end
